sn2.30:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || 2.
sn2.30:1.3: Atha kho sambahulā nānā-titthiya-sāvakā devaputtā Asamo ca Sahalī ca Niṃko ca Ākoṭako ca Veṭambarī ca Māṇava-gāmiyo ca abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Veḷuvanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṃkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || || 3.
sn2.30:1.4: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Asamo devaputto Pūraṇaṃ Kassapam ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.30:3.1: Atha kho Sahalī devaputto Makkhali-Gosālam ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.30:4.4: na hi nūna tādisaṃ karoti pāpan ti || || 5.
sn2.30:5.1: Atha kho Niṃko devaputto Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nāṭaputtaṃ ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.30:6.4: na hi nūna kibbisī siyā ti || || 6.
sn2.30:7.1: Atha kho Ākoṭako devaputto nānātitthiye ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.30:8.4: na hi nūna te sappurisehi dūre ti || || 7.
sn2.30:9.1: Atha kho Veṭambarī devaputto Ākoṭakaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya paccabhāsi || ||
sn2.30:11.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Veṭambariṃ devaputtam anvāvisitvā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.30:13.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya paccabhāsi || ||
sn2.30:14.1: Ye keci rūpā idha vā huraṃ vā
sn2.30:14.4: āmisaṃ va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā ti || || 10.
sn2.30:15.1: Atha kho Māṇava-gāmiyo devaputto Bhagavantam ārabbha Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.30:18.4: Susimo Nānātitthiye ca te dasā ti || ||
